person_note: The central Hope-and-Tru story constitutes the sustained base narration and is told in third person. Nicholas Sparks appears as a participating first-person voice in framing bookends, but those short authorial sections do not override the controlling person of the main novel. Embedded letters and dialogue likewise remain local, so the book label is THIRD.
